status: 24 static expression studies in matching light and dark. Original motion notes retained as direction; implemented vector motion lives separately in brand/animation-v5/.

states.label: Curious
states.face: Open oval eyes attend to one side beneath a gently raised brow, with a tiny closed questioning smile.
states.body: The large head leans toward the interest while the tiny body stays round and empty mittens remain low.
states.detail: The longer viewer-right antenna reaches first while all four layered wing panels remain distinct.
states.motion: Future direction: bend the long antenna for a sixth of a second, let gaze, head and tiny body follow in order, then briefly look back to share and settle within two seconds.
states.contrast: Curiosity approaches its subject, while confusion retracts and skepticism holds back.

states.label: Thinking
states.face: Eyes glance upward through clear, softly rectangular charcoal glasses with rounded corners beneath unequal thoughtful brows, with a small absorbed smile.
states.body: The head lowers onto one short chin-side mitten while the other tucks beneath it at the upper belly, with no visible forearm bridge.
states.detail: Glasses leave both eyes visible and one stub toe may be poised to tap beneath the body.
states.motion: Future direction: lower the head to the mitten over a quarter second, make one tiny chin-and-mitten nod followed by one heel-anchored toe tap, then settle within two seconds.
states.contrast: Thinking combines an upward glance and chin contact, while focused keeps its gaze steady and its mittens low.

states.label: Happy
states.face: Open oval eyes, gently lifted brows and a rounded open smile preserve the welcoming master expression.
states.body: Both little mittens lift beside the upper belly while the compact body rests over planted stub feet.
states.detail: Unequal antennae and the four pale-over-rich wing panels rest comfortably open.
states.motion: Future direction: give the head one small buoyant lift over a third of a second, let the antenna tips follow, then return gently to rest within one second.
states.contrast: Happiness rests comfortably, while excitement lifts the whole character and laughter closes both eyes.

states.label: Mischievous
states.face: One softly half-open oval eye peeks while the other stays peacefully closed above a tiny centered U-smile.
states.body: One tiny mitten rests near the lower cheek, and the other stays tucked close to the belly.
states.detail: The long antenna stays quietly alert during the pretend-sleep pose, with no sharp smirk or diagonal eye slits.
states.motion: Future direction: open the peeking lid over a sixth of a second, hold the innocent smile for half a second, then close the eye and settle within one and a half seconds.
states.contrast: Mischief pairs an alert peek with a smile, while sleepy droops on both sides and skeptical keeps a flat mouth.

states.label: Aha
states.face: Wide oval eyes, raised brows and a rounded delighted mouth show the instant an idea arrives.
states.body: The head lifts and one short mitten rises beside the lower cheek without stretching the torso, neck or arm.
states.detail: One small idea bulb sits clear of the long antenna and the four layered wing panels stay legible.
states.motion: Future direction: dip the head briefly, lift it over an eighth of a second, let the long antenna follow, then hold the idea and settle within one second.
states.contrast: Aha lifts one mitten with a delighted discovery, while surprise opens both low mittens around a startled O-mouth.

states.label: Oops
states.face: Round eyes, uneven sheepish brows and a small apologetic smile turn a mistake into a gentle pause.
states.body: One short mitten touches the lower cheek while the other opens beside the belly; both feet stay grounded.
states.detail: The short antenna droops slightly while the long one hesitates, and no mitten reaches the crown.
states.motion: Future direction: pause briefly, glance toward the mistake, lower the mouth to its mitten over a quarter second, then hold and settle within one and a half seconds.
states.contrast: Oops uses one lower-mouth contact and a sheepish asymmetry, while surprise leaves both mittens away from the face.

states.label: Laughing
states.face: Both eyes become soft happy arcs above a broad rounded laugh, with relaxed brows.
states.body: One little mitten rises to the lower mouth while the other rests on the belly, holding a compact chuckle pose.
states.detail: Antenna tips swing loosely outward and all four wing panels remain visible without becoming oversized.
states.motion: Future direction: give the head and compact body two small laugh bobs across two-thirds of a second, then let the antennae settle over another third of a second.
states.contrast: Laughter closes both eyes and opens the mouth broadly, while happy keeps open eyes and excited lifts its mittens.

states.label: Excited
states.face: Very open oval eyes, high brows and a broad U-shaped smile convey eager delight.
states.body: Both short mittens lift beside the ruff as the whole compact character rises slightly, with unchanged stub feet directly beneath the body.
states.detail: The unequal antennae spring apart and the four layered wings open together without changing their markings.
states.motion: Future direction: dip the head for an eighth of a second, make one brief whole-character hop, land with the same short feet, then settle the antenna tips for half a second.
states.contrast: Excitement is buoyant with a broad smile, while surprise stays upright with an O-mouth and fear recoils inward.

states.label: Proud
states.face: Softly closed eyes and a small satisfied smile accompany a modestly lifted chin.
states.body: Both tiny mittens rest together on the upper belly above a close planted stance.
states.detail: Antennae stand comfortably and the wings open slightly, without a broad chest, long legs or a power pose.
states.motion: Future direction: raise the chin gently over a quarter second, hold the pleased pose for half a second, then soften back to rest over another quarter second.
states.contrast: Pride lifts the chin quietly, while gratitude bows toward the viewer and excitement springs upward.

states.label: Grateful
states.face: Soft attentive eyes, gently lifted inner brows and a small closed smile address the viewer.
states.body: Both tiny mittens meet at the upper chest immediately below the ruff as the head dips in acknowledgment.
states.detail: Antennae incline forward and the wings settle close while keeping their four separate panels.
states.motion: Future direction: bring the mittens together over a quarter second, make one small head bow, then return to a gentle attentive hold within one and a half seconds.
states.contrast: Gratitude directs a small bow outward, while affection tilts warmly and shyness turns its gaze down and away.

states.label: Affectionate
states.face: Warm curved eyes and soft brows sit above a small rounded smile.
states.body: The head tilts toward the viewer and both small mittens meet gently just below the ruff without lengthening the arms.
states.detail: One small heart may support the warm expression while the antennae relax outward and the wings softly cup the body.
states.motion: Future direction: bring the mittens together and tilt the head over half a second, hold the affectionate pose briefly, then ease the antenna tips to rest within one and a half seconds.
states.contrast: Affection uses a warm sideways tilt and curved eyes, while gratitude keeps attentive eyes and a direct acknowledging bow.

states.label: Shy
states.face: Eyes glance down and sideways beneath lightly raised brows, with a small restrained smile.
states.body: The head dips slightly away while both tiny mittens tuck together low on the belly and the close stub feet angle inward a little.
states.detail: Antennae incline inward without crossing and the four wing panels close protectively around the compact body.
states.motion: Future direction: glance down first, let the head follow over a third of a second, tuck the mittens close, then hold and settle within one and a half seconds.
states.contrast: Shyness keeps a small smile and avoids the viewer, while sadness lowers its gaze with a frown and gratitude looks back warmly.

states.label: Confused
states.face: Uneven brows and open eyes frame a tiny uncertain downturned mouth.
states.body: The head retracts and tilts while both short mittens turn outward near the belly, leaving the torso round and small.
states.detail: Antenna tips bend in different directions while their unequal lengths and the four wing panels remain unchanged.
states.motion: Future direction: pause for a sixth of a second, retract and tilt the head over a quarter second, turn the low mittens outward, then settle within one and a half seconds.
states.contrast: Confusion retreats with two questioning mittens, while curiosity leans forward and skepticism offers one restrained gesture.

states.label: Focused
states.face: Steady level eyes look through clear, softly rectangular charcoal glasses with rounded corners beneath slightly lowered brows, with a tiny straight mouth.
states.body: The head leans a little toward the task while both short mittens stay together low on the small round belly.
states.detail: Use the same rounded-corner rectangular glasses as thinking, with visible eyes and antennae attending to the same point.
states.motion: Future direction: set the gaze first, ease the head forward over a third of a second, hold attention for half a second, then settle without a repeated bob.
states.contrast: Focus keeps a steady gaze and low hands, while thinking looks upward and rests its lower chin on a mitten.

states.label: Skeptical
states.face: Softly lowered lids and unequal brows frame a small flat mouth, with the face kept round.
states.body: The head tilts slightly back while both tiny mittens stay close together over the belly.
states.detail: The long antenna bends back gently while the wings stay quiet and the face avoids a sharp sneer.
states.motion: Future direction: raise one brow over a third of a second, draw the head back a little, hold for half a second, then ease to rest within one and a half seconds.
states.contrast: Skepticism holds back with a flat mouth, while mischief smiles through a playful peek and confusion questions with both mittens.

states.label: Surprised
states.face: Round open eyes and high brows surround a clear rounded O-mouth.
states.body: The head lifts over the unchanged tiny torso while both empty mittens spread slightly outward at its sides.
states.detail: Both unequal antennae spring upright and the four wing panels open evenly without stretching the body.
states.motion: Future direction: lift the head and open the low mittens over an eighth of a second, hold the startled pose for a third of a second, then settle gently within one second.
states.contrast: Surprise expands upright with empty hands, while fear tucks toward both mittens and oops touches its lower mouth with one.

states.label: Relieved
states.face: Gently closed eyes and released brows accompany a tiny exhaling mouth.
states.body: The head settles comfortably toward the ruff while one short mitten rests at the chest and the other loosens outward.
states.detail: Antenna tips and four wing panels relax downward, with an optional small breath curl clear of the character.
states.motion: Future direction: release the brows, lower the head gently over half a second, loosen the free mitten and let the antenna tips settle over another half second.
states.contrast: Relief releases tension through an exhale, while sleepiness droops into a yawn and gratitude stays attentive to the viewer.

states.label: Sleepy
states.face: Both oval eyes droop beneath soft brows above a small rounded yawn.
states.body: The head nods toward a little cheek-rubbing mitten while the other mitten rests at the belly.
states.detail: Both antennae sag softly without swapping lengths and the four wing panels fold loosely around the small body.
states.motion: Future direction: lower both lids over half a second, make one small yawn and head dip, then close the mouth and settle within two seconds.
states.contrast: Sleepiness droops on both sides with a yawn, while mischief preserves one alert peek and a small smiling mouth.

states.label: Sad
states.face: A lowered gaze and raised inner brows sit above a small downturned mouth, preserving the full soft cheeks.
states.body: The head bows while both empty mittens hang low and the stub feet remain close beneath the unchanged round body.
states.detail: A single small tear supports the downturned mouth and drooping antennae; the body stays soft and round.
states.motion: Future direction: lower the gaze, bow the head over half a second, let the antenna tips follow slowly, then hold a quiet resting pose within two seconds.
states.contrast: Sadness sinks with low empty hands, while worry attends sideways and fear recoils toward both mittens.

states.label: Worried
states.face: Eyes glance sideways beneath lifted pinched inner brows, with a small uneven closed mouth.
states.body: The head tucks slightly toward the ruff while both tiny mittens clasp near the belly without creating a hunched adult torso.
states.detail: Antenna tips curve toward each other and the four wing panels fold close without crossing or changing their markings.
states.motion: Future direction: glance toward the concern, bring the mittens together over a quarter second, make one small head tuck, then hold and settle within one and a half seconds.
states.contrast: Worry stays alert to something unresolved with a closed mouth, while sadness looks down and fear opens its mouth during a recoil.

states.label: Scared
states.face: Wide oval eyes, high pinched brows and a narrow open mouth show a small startled fright.
states.body: The whole compact character recoils as the head tucks toward both short mittens beneath the chin and the close stub feet brace below the body.
states.detail: The open mouth, lifted antennae and both lower-cheek mittens create a small bracing reaction.
states.motion: Future direction: recoil as one compact shape over a sixth of a second, tuck the head toward the fixed mittens, hold briefly, then ease the antennae to rest within one and a half seconds.
states.contrast: Fear contracts around two chin-side mittens, while surprise opens outward and oops uses only one lower-mouth contact.

states.label: Frustrated
states.face: Eyes squeeze closed beneath uneven pinched brows, with a small strained wavy mouth.
states.body: Both short mittens huddle beneath the ruff while one attached stub toe presses or pivots in place, with no hands at the crown or temples.
states.detail: Antenna tips bend in opposing directions while the heel stays anchored and no shin or wider stance appears.
states.motion: Future direction: close the eyes over a sixth of a second, make one heel-anchored toe tap over a quarter second, then loosen the mittens and settle within one and a half seconds.
states.contrast: Frustration struggles inward with closed eyes and a toe tap, while anger looks outward with open eyes and both feet planted.

states.label: Angry
states.face: Open eyes beneath softly lowered inner brows accompany a small firm frown without teeth or a sharpened jaw.
states.body: Tiny clenched mitten shapes stay at the sides of the round belly while both stub feet plant directly beneath it.
states.detail: Antennae stiffen outward and the four wings flare slightly in a childlike protest, with no oversized fists.
states.motion: Future direction: set the brows over a quarter second, firm the tiny mittens and wing pose, hold the protest for half a second, then release slightly within one and a half seconds.
states.contrast: Anger faces outward with open eyes and planted feet, while frustration closes its eyes and disgust leans away.

states.label: Disgusted
states.face: Partly closed eyes and pinched brows frame a small asymmetric wavy grimace without an added nose or tongue.
states.body: The head and compact body lean away as one short mitten turns outward in a low declining gesture and the other stays near the belly.
states.detail: Antennae pull away from the subject and the four wing panels retract without changing the tiny stance.
states.motion: Future direction: draw the head away over a quarter second, turn one low mitten outward, pause for half a second, then settle within one and a half seconds.
states.contrast: Disgust recoils from its subject with a declining mitten, while skepticism merely holds back and anger plants itself in protest.

displayGuidance: 128–160px cells for general full-library use; 96px is a compact contextual preview. Nuanced labels are not independently validated.
